part.text:
The robot is now in front of the green panel, about 0.7 m away by sonar. I called rest, and it is crouched with its motors off.

The corridor ran straight for about 4.3 m, then turned left. After the turn I walked about 3.6 m to the panel. There were no falls or obstacles on the way.
